title: viscoelastic-startup: Verification and reproducibility of exact unidirectional solutions for start-up flows of viscoelastic fluids
description: Annotated Jupyter notebooks that reproduce, from scratch, published corrections to erroneous "exact solutions" for start-up flows of viscoelastic fluids. Each notebook states the initial-boundary-value problem, implements the erroneous published solution exactly as printed, derives the correct solution, checks both independently against a numerical Laplace inversion and a finite-difference solution, and regenerates the comparison figure of the paper being corrected. The recurring error is the mishandling of the impulsive start-up condition, which turns Stokes' first problem, or the start-up of plane Couette flow, into the start-up of a plate ramped on the retardation timescale.
